errors.evidence: The description incorrectly expands the abbreviation "ДМА" from the figure caption. In the context of Bulgarian enterprises ("предприятията"), "ДМА" stands for "Дълготрайни материални активи" (Fixed Tangible Assets), not "директната материална антропогенна активност" (Direct Material Anthropogenic Activity). This fundamentally misrepresents the subject of the chart.

errors.text_span: обхващаща диапазона от 0 до 450 000 хил. лв., с етикети на всеки 50 000 хил. лв.
errors.evidence: The description is redundant and potentially confusing when stating the y-axis range and intervals. The axis label is "хил. лв." (thousands of BGN) and the values are listed as 50000, 100000, etc. Stating a value as "450 000 хил. лв." is repetitive and can be read as "450,000 thousand BGN". This phrasing is used for all monetary values in the description, making it verbose.
